put.summary:
Sets an application's status. The single place status changes: when the status
differs, `status_changed_at` and `updated_at` move and a `status_changed` event is
written. Non-blank `feedback` (only with `rejected`) also writes a `rejection_feedback`
event and moves `updated_at`, even if the application was already rejected. The same
status without feedback is a no-op that returns the row unchanged.

200.description: The application with its new status

400.description: The body is not valid JSON for this route, or `status` is unknown

403.description: The `Host` header is not a local address, or the request came from another site or as an HTML form

422.description: `feedback` is too long, or given with a status other than `rejected`

500.description: The status could not be stored

Application.description: One `applications` row: the body of every route that returns an application.

comp.description: Compensation as free text, e.g. "$180k–$210k + equity".

resume_version_id.description:
The resume version sent with this application. Only
`PUT /applications/{id}/resume` changes it.

source.description: Where the role came from as free text, e.g. "Referral".

status_changed_at.description: When `status` last changed (the creation time until then).

url.description: The job posting, an absolute http or https URL.

ApplicationEvent.description: One `application_events` row. Which of the optional fields are set depends on `kind`.

stage_name.description: The stage's name when the event was written, for the `stage_*` kinds.

oneOf.description: Set for `status_changed` and (except for backfilled rows) `created`.

ApplicationInput.description:
The `PUT /applications/{id}` body: every text field, replacing the stored ones. An
omitted optional field is cleared. Unknown keys, `status` included, are ignored.

company.description: Required; a missing or blank value is a 422.

title.description: Required; a missing or blank value is a 422.

ApplicationStatus.description: Where an application is in the process.

Capture.description: A capture: the 200 body, and a succeeded `capture_extract` job's `result`.

CaptureFailure.description: The 502 body. It never includes page content.

CaptureFailureReason.description: Why the page couldn't be read.

CaptureQueued.description: The 202 body: Claude will read the page in this job.

url.description: The job posting's absolute http or https URL. Required.

CapturedFields.description:
The fields for the add form, normalised: trimmed, blank as `null`, at most 200
characters each.

url.description: The trimmed URL the user submitted.

ConnectionState.description: Whether a Google account is connected.

EntryKind.description: The kinds of entry the user writes directly.

oneOf.description: An application was created; `application` is the `POST /applications` body.
An application's text or status changed; `application` is the route's body.
An agent run changed; `run` is the `agent_runs` row as `GET /runs` returns it.
The kill switch changed; `kill_switch` is the `GET /kill-switch` body.
`DELETE /data` emptied every user table; refetch everything.

Event.description: One event on the bus. It serializes with its name in `"type"`.

field.description: The JSON field name, or `body` when the body itself didn't parse.

revoked.description:
Whether Google confirmed the revocation. When `false`, remove the grant by hand at
<https://myaccount.google.com/permissions>.

GoogleRevocation.description: What happened to the Google grant when all data was deleted.

configured.description: Whether the client id, secret and token key are all set.

connected_at.description: When the account was last connected; `null` when disconnected.

scopes.description: The granted scopes, sorted; empty when disconnected.

Job.description: One `jobs` row. This is also the `GET /jobs/<id>` body; the payload is not echoed.

result.description: Any JSON value the job produced.

run_at.description: The earliest time the job may start.

NewApplication.description:
The `POST /applications` body: the [`ApplicationInput`] fields plus an optional
starting status (`sourced` when omitted).

company.description: Required; a missing or blank value is a 422.

title.description: Required; a missing or blank value is a 422.

ResumeVersion.description: One resume version, without its text or bytes: the `GET /resumes` item.

application_count.description: How many applications reference this version.

has_text.description: Whether text could be extracted from the PDF.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the PDF bytes, lowercase hex.

text.description: The extracted text, or `null` when none could be extracted.

ResumeVersionDetail.description: One resume version with its extracted text: the `GET /resumes/{id}` body.

cost_usd.description: Sum of the steps' reported cost in US dollars.

error.description: The latest step error; cleared when the run succeeds.

input.description: The JSON the run was started with; the first step's input.

input_tokens.description: Sum of the steps' input tokens (including cache tokens).

output.description: The last step's output, once the run has succeeded.

RunDetail.description: The `GET /runs/{id}` body: the run with its steps in order.

attempts.description: How many times the step has started.

claude_call_id.description: The step's most recent successful model call.

input.description: The previous step's output (the run's input for the first step), once started.

input_tokens.description: Tokens and cost of the step's model and tool calls, across attempts.

ordinal.description: The step's position in the workflow, from 0.

RunStepDetail.description: A step with its tool calls, oldest first.

completed_at.description: When the stage was completed; null while it is open. Always serialized.

position.description: 0 for the first stage, counting up without gaps.

stage_ids.description: Every stage id of the application, each once, in the new order.

feedback.description:
Rejection feedback, recorded as a `rejection_feedback` event. Allowed only with
`rejected`; blank means none. At most 20,000 characters.

claude_call_id.description: The model call that asked for the tool, if any.

input_tokens.description: Tokens and cost of the model calls the tool made.

oneOf.description: The tool's permission level; `null` for an unknown tool.

tool.description: The tool's name as the caller gave it.

ValidationErrors.description: The 400 and 422 body: every failing field at once.
